mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document ( id, kb_id, filename, source_key, filetype, size, metadata, content_hash, index_fingerprint, index_version, index_status, chunk_count, indexed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( COALESCE(CAST(#{id} AS uuid), gen_random_uuid()), CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid), #{filename}, #{sourceKey}, #{filetype}, #{size}, CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb), #{contentHash}, #{indexFingerprint}, COALESCE(#{indexVersion}, 0), COALESCE(#{indexStatus}, 'EMPTY'), COALESCE(#{chunkCount}, 0), #{indexedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id, filename, source_key, filetype, size, metadata::text AS metadata, content_hash, index_fingerprint, index_version, index_status, chunk_count, indexed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM document WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

SELECT id, kb_id, filename, source_key, filetype, size, metadata::text AS metadata, content_hash, index_fingerprint, index_version, index_status, chunk_count, indexed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM document ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT d.id, d.kb_id, d.filename, d.source_key, d.filetype, d.size, d.metadata::text AS metadata, d.content_hash, d.index_fingerprint, d.index_version, d.index_status, d.chunk_count, d.indexed_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM document d INNER JOIN knowledge_base kb ON kb.id = d.kb_id WHERE kb.owner_id = CAST(#{ownerId} AS uuid) ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC

SELECT id, kb_id, filename, source_key, filetype, size, metadata::text AS metadata, content_hash, index_fingerprint, index_version, index_status, chunk_count, indexed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM document WHERE kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id, kb_id, filename, source_key, filetype, size, metadata::text AS metadata, content_hash, index_fingerprint, index_version, index_status, chunk_count, indexed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM document WHERE kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid) AND source_key = #{sourceKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.update:
UPDATE document
kb_id = CAST(#{kbId} AS uuid),
filename = #{filename},
source_key = #{sourceKey},
filetype = #{filetype},
size = #{size},
metadata = CAST(#{metadata} AS jsonb),
content_hash = #{contentHash},
index_fingerprint = #{indexFingerprint},
index_version = #{indexVersion},
index_status = #{indexStatus},
chunk_count = #{chunkCount},
indexed_at = #{indexedAt},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)

UPDATE document SET filename = #{document.filename}, source_key = #{document.sourceKey}, filetype = #{document.filetype}, size = #{document.size}, metadata = CAST(#{document.metadata} AS jsonb), content_hash = #{document.contentHash}, index_fingerprint = #{document.indexFingerprint}, index_version = #{document.indexVersion}, index_status = #{document.indexStatus}, chunk_count = #{document.chunkCount}, indexed_at = #{document.indexedAt}, updated_at = #{document.updatedAt} WHERE id = CAST(#{document.id} AS uuid) AND index_version = #{expectedVersion}
